children.text: , CEO of O3, wrote for the Bureau of Digital’s blog on how COVID-19 has impacted the work practices at the company, and how he’s always valued an in-office team.

“For all of the damage and distress COVID-19 has created, it forced us into thinking differently. How we work, where we work and in many cases, what kind of work are we now doing.” – Keith Scandone, CEO

Citing O3’s impact on the hyper-local community economy, the ease of in-person collaboration and communication, and his desire to remain connected to the personal and professional growth of his employees, Keith reiterates the value of in-person work, while giving a nod to the distinct advantages of distributed teams.
Here’s why he believes the melding of in-office and remote will create the best environment for all
